text: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial phenomena, delving into the vastness of space and the objects that inhabit it. At its core, orbit is the path that planets and other bodies follow around a star, an essential concept that guides astronomers in their investigations. Beyond the orbit, craters are the remnants of ancient collisions, often revealing the rough surfaces and varying compositions of celestial bodies. These craters provide critical insights into the history and dynamics of our solar system, as well as the broader universe, by offering clues about the forces that shape and wear down the cosmos. Through observations of these formations and others, astronomers piece together a complex portrait of the universe, revealing its vastness, age, and the mysteries that lie within its enigmatic corners.
